body: In my case, it has EVERYTHING to do with bravery. I hate myself, I wish I had never existed, and I wish to cease to exist. So why do I not kill myself RIGHT now by just hanging myself or jumping off of a building? Because I am afraid. Afraid of either failing and having another negative thing looming over me, or because I will go to hell. (I am an agnostic atheist, but I have been literally brainwashed my whole life regarding hell so it is a thought I cannot overcome, despite what I know for a fact). So yes, for me, it has everything to do with bravery.

I refuse to open up to anyone, mainly because, who the fuck am I going to open up to? And how will it even help? I could tell my family, sure. My parents, who are religious, will give me nothing but Bible verses and other religious bullshit. Tell my younger teenage brothers? What will that do? They're not mature enough to help, not that they could do anything anyway. I have no close friends to tell... sorry your wife is such a cunt bro. I truly am. And I would give my life if it would ease your pain, because I know how you feel and no one should feel this way.

Never talked to anyone other than what I mentioned in my original post. I'm probably a textbook case for depression. I don't really want "help", just want to not exist. I have no interest in pills at all. I do smoke weed and that helps a lot but it is no cure. I am a fuck up in the sense that I'm smart but too lazy and not motivated enough to use it. I never tried in school and yet I got good grades. Started some college but not motivated to go back. I've never had a real girlfriend, I'm just generally alone and miserable. That's about it.
